experiment: Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0 TP2 concurrency-two row-exact MMVQ split
hypothesis: Splitting Q8 ne[1]==2 into two no-copy ne[1]==1 MMVQ launches would retain the sequential single-row arithmetic and remove c2 schedule-dependent greedy output changes.

identity.source_lineage: mndodd/llama.cpp intel-sycl-optimization plus the accepted Qwen3.8 Q8 TP2 patch stack

configuration.server: TP2 1/1, parallel=2, ctx=16384, batch=1024, ubatch=256, F16 KV, flash attention, reasoning off, no speculation
configuration.capture: two cache-cold sequential fixed-slot oracles followed by two barrier-synchronized 256-token streams
configuration.build: Release, oneAPI 2026.1 icpx, bmg_g31 AOT, SYCL/F16/Level-Zero support on, DNN/graph/host fallback off

quality.decision: The patch improves c2 throughput slightly but does not repair the disjoint-prompt schedule-dependent output divergence. It is not quality-preserving and must not be promoted.

post_run: Both devices normal, idle at 400 MHz, no new Xe fault/reset/hang/device-lost/CAT error in the current boot log.
